lines: This is Season of Tickets. In this social Megapot game, the last seat standing wins.
A crew pools real lottery entries. When someone leaves, their seat becomes the next contest.
The live season board turns tickets into a shared strategy: crew up, fund the pot, and call it.
Here, two mainnet purchases produced three scored tickets and a three USDC crew chest.
The ladder and feed make every move visible: seats, events, and the moment the pot is called.
To exit, a player bids a bigger discount back to the crew. The auction only moves forward, and late bids extend the clock.
Nothing is assumed. Real Base receipts are decoded, confirmed, and checked before settlement can continue.
Then the chest opens. One player exits, one ticket returns as a bonus, and survivor shares renormalize.
Season of Tickets: a social layer for Megapot, built for the Inco Summer Game Jam. Crew up. Call the pot.

bgm.prompt: Instrumental dark-electronic game-show score for a 60-second onchain game demo. Start with a tense analog pulse and sparse sub bass, add clipped synth percussion and rising arpeggios through the auction, then resolve into a warm confident chord sequence for the receipt reveal and end card.
bgm.arc: Hook → Tontine premise → The game (real UI) → Real-entry proof → The call/auction → Receipt verification → Settlement reveal → CTA
